meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按“先理解代码库→写 TypeScript 代码→构建→在真实浏览器截图验证→部署→线上复核”的顺序做前端任务，不经过验证不会宣称完成。
howto.when: 当用户要求新建、修改或部署网站/网页应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我给现有 React 项目加一个移动端导航栏，改完截图验证。
say.note: Claude 会修改代码并截图给你看。

say.text: 用 Vite 搭一个单页应用，构建通过后再部署到生产环境。
say.note: 他会按流程构建，再调用部署工具上线。

say.text: 检查这个页面的可访问性和响应式，有问题就修复并截图。
say.note: 他会按清单逐项检查并修复。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude follows a strict frontend workflow: understand the codebase, write TypeScript, build, verify visually in a real browser with screenshots, deploy, and re-check the live URL. It never declares done without visual proof.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, modify, or deploy a website or web app.

say_en.text: Add a mobile nav bar to my existing React project, then verify with screenshots.
say_en.note: Claude will edit and show screenshots.

say_en.text: Scaffold a SPA with Vite, build it, then deploy to production.
say_en.note: He follows the workflow and deploys.

say_en.text: Audit this page for accessibility and responsiveness, fix issues, and screenshot.
